name: deft-directive-build
description: Build a project from scope xBRIEFs following Deft Directive framework standards. Use after deft-directive-setup has generated the project definition, or when the user has story xBRIEFs in xbrief/active/ ready to implement. Handles scaffolding, implementation, testing, and quality checks phase by phase.

findings.excerpt: vitest run --coverage <changed-paths>   # or project test runner on touched modules
- ! Never emit commands containing pipes or redirections through the agent shell tool on this runtime. For anything needing a pipe, use one of: Python one-liner
- ! The `scripts/` Python directory was removed in #2022 (TS-native migration). All subprocess capture rules from this section now apply to TS tooling only -- t
- ! TS scripts that shell out for parsable output (gh, git, task) MUST use `execa` or `child_process.spawn` with `encoding: "utf8"` -- never `execSync` with def
